items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was very important in the development of jazz in Chicago, Lank Keyes.

ctx.x: And he made an arrangement of it?

Yeah, it goes through a lot of changes. He had the original stock chart of it. It was written out on big paper, on manuscript paper. I remember him. He was very important in the development of jazz in Chicago, Lank Keyes.
